flows.description: A short checklist of what to have ready before a diagnostic visit. Send when the contact asks what happens at the visit or how to prepare.
The booking and payment link. Send when the contact asks for the link or says they want to book.

fields.description: Where the sale stands with this contact.
Which appliance the contact needs looked at. Ask before offering anything.
What this contact is buying. Set it as soon as they choose, or the fit is clear.
Whether the contact means to buy. Record prospect once they ask about a price, a booking time or how to pay; not_prospect if they write for something else.
